title: Containerise all services

user_story.i_want: every Stratum service built into a small container image and runnable with compose
user_story.so_that: the whole platform starts with one command

description: Write one multi-stage Dockerfile using cargo-chef for dependency caching that builds all binaries in release, on a slim runtime base. Add per-service compose entries under profile `app` that depend on infrastructure healthchecks. Tune the release profile (thin LTO, codegen-units, strip) and record binary sizes before and after. This ties back to our 'native binaries' discussion: glibc vs musl linking.

acceptance_criteria.given: the full compose with profile app
acceptance_criteria.then: the whole pipeline works end to end
each is under 50 MB (actual sizes noted)
the dependency layer is reused (cache hit)

rust_concepts: Static vs dynamic linking (glibc vs musl)
